raw.cause: camera was destroyed at 3274.8 ms (91117) after replying normally to every request (last round trip 83151/83161/83171). On display's next tick, MsgSend() on the stale camera connection failed. run_display() treats that -1 as fatal ('camera failed, giving up', return 1), so display exited and was destroyed 30 ms later (95162) instead of continuing to serve nav/logger traffic as the isolation contract requires.
raw.qnx_call: MsgSend in display (error from MsgSend to dead camera handled as fatal in run_display)
raw.fix_summary: Do not exit when the camera MsgSend fails. Degrade to 'camera stale/no camera' and keep drawing. Best is to always use the COCKPIT_FIXED path: a separate camera_reader thread owns the camera connection, and the main loop only reads last_frame. That also covers the camera-hang case, where a TimerTimeout would not help because name_attach channels have _NTO_CHF_UNBLOCK. Minimal patch: on error, close the coid, mark the camera gone and continue the loop.
